children.game_version: A 'freeze-jump' game where children jump to the music and freeze when it stops.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the vertical arm and torso movements while seated, focusing on rhythm.
seniors.standing_version: Perform a gentle, low-impact bounce without leaving the ground.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and limited range of motion.

movement_profile.partnering: None; individual movement in a group.

signature_moves.description: Jumping straight up and down while keeping the torso stiff.
signature_moves.name: Vertical Jump

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Deliberate physical harm to others; ignoring fallen participants.

reference_recordings.artist: Patricio Rey y sus Redonditos de Ricota
reference_recordings.title: Ji ji ji

music_profile.sound_description: Fast-paced, distorted electric guitars and a heavy, driving drum beat create an urgent, high-energy atmosphere that compels the listener to move.

basic_steps: Stand with feet together and torso upright.
Keep arms rigid at your sides.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner: Focus on vertical jumping on the spot. Intermediate: Incorporate movement around the space. Advanced: Integrate with crowd dynamics.
